title: SYSK The Podcast: Special Halloween Bonus Episode 2016, The Sequel – From Hell
summary: Special Halloween bonus episode (2016 sequel, "From Hell") in which Josh Clark and Chuck Bryant read Ed Grabowski's (transcribed as Grabanowski) horror story "Extraneous Invocation," about a man whose wife becomes a shapeshifting creature after a move between apartments, then read a batch of two-sentence horror stories submitted by listeners, with commentary on them, plus tangents on Stephen King's Dollar Babies, "Weird Al" Yankovic, and Alfred Hitchcock Presents.

segments.title: Opening banter and Halloween setup
segments.summary: Josh and Chuck introduce the Halloween bonus episode, joke about the episode title and Josh's candy corn and corn whiskey hot toddy, and preview the two stories and the listener two-sentence horror submissions.

segments.title: Story: Extraneous Invocation by Ed Grabowski
segments.summary: Chuck and Josh read Ed Grabowski's story about a narrator whose wife Laura seems to change during a move between apartments, with wet hair, a clicking laugh, and nights of terror. The narrator eventually discovers he is also being taken over, and the story ends with him harming Laura. Hosts comment on the story and Grabowski's writing.

segments.title: Post-story chat: Dollar Babies and Weird Al
segments.summary: Josh and Chuck discuss Stephen King's Dollar Babies program, in which unoptioned short stories can be licensed for a dollar, and Chuck mentions Weird Al Yankovic's tweeted payphone call-in.

segments.title: Listener two-sentence horror stories
segments.summary: The hosts read about twenty two-sentence horror stories submitted by listeners, with brief critiques and reactions, including tangents on a Friday the 13th reference, an Alfred Hitchcock Presents remake, and a brother's prank. They close with a discussion of violence against women and minorities as horror tropes.

segments.title: Sign-off and contact information
segments.summary: Chuck gives social media and email contact information and the hosts wish listeners a happy Halloween.

segments.title: Closing credit
segments.summary: Closing tagline directing listeners to HowStuffWorks.com for more topics.
